name: GET /api/leadflow/handoffs/:id - the sales-to-onboarding record
description:
The handoff, its 24-hour clock and its acceptance state.

ACCEPTANCE AND A BOOKED KICKOFF ARE SEPARATE FACTS and closed_won_terminal is their conjunction. Accepted-with-no-kickoff is the state that looks finished on a list and is not — somebody said "yes, mine" and then nothing happened, which from the customer's side is identical to nobody accepting at all.

When sdk-handoff is unreachable the drafted document is unavailable but the LOCAL record still answers, and the local record is the one the 24-hour alert reads.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the handoff id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
